inputs.items:
REQ-001 The user shall login with username and password before accessing the dashboard
REQ-002 The system must support OAuth2 token refresh for API sessions
REQ-003 Guest users can preview the landing page without authentication
REQ-004 The user shall export filtered requirements to XLSX with a summary sheet
REQ-005 The app must download a JSON session containing inputs and classification results
REQ-006 The table view shall allow scanning category item id description tokens and score
REQ-007 Buttons and error toasts must remain visible on narrow mobile screens
REQ-008 The system shall store audit events when a requirement category is changed
REQ-009 Audit logs must include previous category new category timestamp and user id
REQ-010 The classifier should ignore temporary preview data when exporting final results
REQ-011 The API integration shall retry failed webhook delivery three times
REQ-012 The system must validate imported session JSON before applying it
REQ-013 Large input batches of 5000 requirements should classify without freezing the browser
REQ-014 Tokenization should remove accents and common stopwords from Spanish descriptions
REQ-015 Email notifications shall be sent when a reviewed requirement remains uncategorized
REQ-016 Notification templates must not include password or secret token values
REQ-017 Administrators shall manage category seeds phrases negative rules and regex patterns
REQ-018 The app must remain fully offline and avoid external network calls
REQ-019 The UI shall show matched rules and negative-rule notes for every supervised result
REQ-020 The integration endpoint must reject invalid payload signatures
inputs.seeds:
AUTH: login,password,oauth,token,session,"accessing the dashboard",-/guest|preview|notification/
EXPORT: export,xlsx,download,spreadsheet,"summary sheet","json session",-preview
UI: table,button,toast,screen,mobile,dashboard,"table view",-/api|webhook/
AUDIT: audit,log,timestamp,"previous category","new category","matched rules"
INTEGRATION: api,webhook,endpoint,payload,signature,retry,"external network",-offline
PERFORMANCE: large,batch,5000,freezing,browser,"without freezing"
DATA_QUALITY: validate,imported,json,tokenization,accents,stopwords,regex,"negative rules"
NOTIFICATIONS: email,notification,template,uncategorized,-password,-token
OFFLINE: offline,"fully offline","external network calls",-/webhook|api/
